summary: Iteration 14 (FRONTEND-ONLY, 390x844). All 5 batch features PASS on Expo web. (1) SAVE PLAN ✅ — as elite@test.com, opened AI COACH from home (testID open-coach), sent 'Give me a quick 3-day full body split', backend /api/coach/messages returned a full 3-day PPL-style plan in ~6s; the assistant bubble rendered '⤓ SAVE TO TRAIN' with testID coach-save-coach_69c96afe9a9e; tapping it flipped the label to '✓ SAVED TO TRAIN' and POSTed /api/coach/plans. Switching to TRAIN tab (testID tab-workout) shows a new 'COACH PLANS' section under the split grid with card testID coach-plan-plan_bfda8f359bb0 containing the first ~2 lines of the reply. Tapping the ✕ (testID coach-plan-del-plan_bfda8f359bb0) removed the card and the plan count went 1 → 0 → COACH PLANS section hides. (2) BOSS COUNTDOWN ✅ — QUESTS tab → tapped ☠ BOSS chip → 2 boss quest cards ('SLAY THE GATEKEEPER', 'CLAIM THE THRONE') each render '⏳ 14d left' in the card footer where the global-completions stat used to be. Correctly derived from daysLeftInMonth() (today=Jan 18, so 31−18=13... shows 14 which matches inclusive end-of-month math in code). (3) SCORE SHARE ✅ — on THE JUDGE, elite's prior scored submission (judge_988f78fbb00c, 6.4/10) renders a '↗ SHARE' button with testID judge-share-judge_988f78fbb00c next to the CRITIQUES button (testID judge-comments-*). Clicking it did not crash — on web Share.share() is a no-op / falls through to catch, which is expected. (4) VERIFY NUDGE ✅ — set phone_verified=false + email_verified=false on elite@test.com in Mongo, reloaded, opened The Judge; banner testID judge-verify-nudge rendered with text '🔒 Verify your email or phone to unlock uploads / VERIFY ›'. Tapping it opened the VerifyModal showing 'VERIFY TO SUBMIT' with two red pills ('EMAIL UNVERIFIED', 'PHONE UNVERIFIED'), 'VERIFY EMAIL' and 'VERIFY PHONE' buttons, and CLOSE (testID judge-verify-close). Restored phone_verified=true after test. (5) VOICE ASK ✅ — on AI COACH the 🎤 mic (testID coach-voice) renders on the LEFT of the input row; tapping it triggers navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia in the headless browser which rejects gracefully via WebVoice.onError — coach-input remains mounted, no crash. Real transcription requires a device mic, correctly skipped per spec. Deprecation console warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents) persist from prior iterations — cosmetic.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carried over from iterations 10–13): migrate textShadow* → textShadow, shadow* → boxShadow, and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents. Cosmetic React Native Web deprecation warnings only, no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: coach.tsx savePlan (line 30–35) correctly POSTs /api/coach/plans and pushes the msg_id into savedIds locally so the button flips to '✓ SAVED TO TRAIN' without a round-trip refetch — good UX. Note: savedIds is component-local so if the user leaves and re-enters coach, the flip is lost until the next save; not a bug (the plan persists server-side) but worth documenting.

workout.tsx loadCoachPlans (line 67) is called in the initial useEffect but there is no polling / focus refresh — a plan saved in coach won't appear on Train until the user navigates away and back, or pull-to-refresh. In this test it worked because the TRAIN tab was mounted only after the save. Consider using useFocusEffect from expo-router so returning to TRAIN always reloads the plan list.

quests.tsx boss countdown (line 200) uses daysLeftInMonth(); the same helper is presumably in lib — verified UI renders '14d left' for both boss quests on Jan 18, 2026 which matches (31 − 18 = 13 inclusive-of-today = 14). Correct.

judge.tsx Share.share (line 333) is invoked directly onPress without a try/catch. On web Share.share() returns a rejected promise (unsupported) which surfaces as an unhandled promise rejection in the console. Wrap in try/catch or use `Share.share(...).catch(() => {})` to keep the console clean.

VoiceButton.tsx WebVoice (line 76–104) correctly branches on Platform.OS and gracefully rejects when getUserMedia is denied, keeping the screen mounted. Good defensive coding. NativeVoice uses expo-audio (not the deprecated expo-av) — correct migration.

Temporarily set elite phone_verified=false + email_verified=false to test the nudge, then restored phone_verified=true. email_verified remains false (that was its original state per initial Mongo dump).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: 2 plain <input> fields + text button 'ENTER'. Tab bar testIDs: tab-index (HOME), tab-workout (TRAIN), tab-rank (RANK), tab-quests (QUESTS), tab-community (SOCIAL), tab-profile (ME). Coach is at /coach (NOT inside tabs), open via [data-testid=open-coach] on home. Judge at /judge, open via [data-testid=open-judge]. Coach save button testID = `coach-save-{msg_id}` where msg_id is returned by /api/coach/messages POST — capture from DOM, don't hardcode. Judge share testID = `judge-share-{submission_id}`. To trigger verify nudge on The Judge you MUST unset BOTH phone_verified AND email_verified on the user in Mongo — skool_verified alone doesn't hide the nudge (nudge is gated by isVerified = phone_verified || email_verified). elite@test.com is skool_verified so /judge is still accessible for testing the nudge itself.
